name: aigw-usage
description: Shows your budget on the AI gateway in the status line and warns before it is spent

hub_url.title: Hub address
hub_url.description: The address of the AI Gateway Control hub, e.g. https://aigw.example.com. Empty uses AIGW_HUB_URL.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: Your key for the gateway. Empty uses AIGW_API_KEY, then the key Claude Code sends (ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY).

warn_at.title: Warn at, percent
warn_at.description: Tell me once when a budget has been used this far.
